schemaFieldEquality.law: for every rooted type, root field list is byte-identical to typed schema field list; signatures live only in receipt schemas

authorityLaw.leaseGrant: LeaseGrantMessageV5 is unsigned and binds leaseRoot, leaseId, ledger predecessor/version, holder, commit authority, policy, and issuer; LeaseGrantReceiptV5 signature is outside it
authorityLaw.commit: CommitMessageV5 is unsigned and contains no signature; CommitReceiptV5 signature binds only its messageRoot
authorityLaw.ledger: LedgerVersionV5 and LedgerTransitionMessageV5 bind leaseRoot as well as leaseId; OPEN->HELD and FINISHED->COMMITTED use exact predecessor roots and CAS observations
authorityLaw.derivation: behavior class derives from authenticated ActionDefinition body through BehaviorDerivationReceiptV5; effect status derives from authenticated EffectTraceV5; neither is caller input

controlTargetLaw.schemaMembership: every material row semanticField is a direct exact member of typedSchemas[semanticAuthorityKind]; semanticFieldSchemaIndex is its exact index
controlTargetLaw.instanceJoin: each before/after ControlProductionInstanceV5 binds the matching concrete semanticAuthorityRoot and /semanticField path consumed by its source-bound predicate
controlTargetLaw.commitSignature: leafCommitSignature targets CommitReceiptV5.signatureBytesHex, never a CommitMessage signature field
